topography.project_purpose: Bridge. Structurally: 72 project-authored contract(s) across 15 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs, 5 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, typeandversioninterface, simplereadaccesscontroller). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
